Creating SEO content briefs includes giving some SEO guidelines, including secondary keywords and topics to cover in your content.

You just need to click on the keyword and add it to the outline. The keywords you’re selecting will be automatically grouped with our AI to make them as useful as possible for you.

You can approach adding secondary keywords in SEOwind from 2 different angles:

1. Going through [Competitive Analysis](https://seowind.io/competitive-analysis-seo/) by analyzing each SERP. Here you can find keywords the page ranks in the top 30, with a search volume above 10. Based on keyword difficulty and search volume you can make the decision about which ones you want to cover.

![seowind add keyword to brief](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/seowind-add-keyword-to-outline-1024x477.png)

2. Dig deeper by looking through the Secondary keywords section and understand better the context a particular keyword was used in.

![seowind secondary keywords context](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/seowind-secondary-keywords-context-1024x476.png)
